result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on prior finding 02F-001 and the directly touched message read-back surface. The production listMessages path now exposes stored derived forms alongside messages, TC-2.1 proves that path, and focused/story/epic gates passed.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: Resolved by production code and test evidence. MessageRecord now carries optional `forms` (`packages/lhc/src/domains/messages/index.ts:30`), listMessages attaches forms from `readMessageForms` before returning records (`packages/lhc/src/domains/messages/index.ts:198`), and readMessageForms maps stored message-owned derived_form rows verbatim (`packages/lhc/src/domains/messages/internal/forms.ts:66`). TC-2.1 now asserts the ready smoothed form through `sdk.messages.listMessages` on `message.forms` (`packages/lhc/test/derivation-messages.test.ts:104`) and keeps a raw-row agreement check (`packages/lhc/test/derivation-messages.test.ts:125`).
